<b>Pilgrim Hikers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are hard-shelled bugs who use a climber's pin as both a walking stick and a weapon.<ref>Pilgrim Hiker [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Hard-shelled bug with a climber's pin. Their pin, once aid, has become a weapon, though the bug is unrefined in its use."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Pilgrim Hikers either slowly wander back and forth, or are hiding in their shells in place, and do not make any attempt to pursue Hornet. Once Hornet is in range, they may use any of the following moves:
* <b>Triple Thrust:</b> Thrusts forward with their pin thrice.
* <b>Slash:</b> Raises its pin before doing a large outwards slash that also hits slightly above themselves.
* <b>Shell Retreat:</b> Tucks itself into its shell for 1.5 seconds, blocking any Needle strikes and most Tools; if they successfully block an attack, they will immediately respond with either of the 2 moves listed above.
* <b>Leap:</b> Leaps either backwards or forwards to reposition, shortening their Leap to not fall off an edge.

Their inferior attacks frequently leave them very exposed, creating many openings for counterattack. Plus, they are not exactly adept at protecting themselves from above.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Pilgrim Hikers have their health tripled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Pilgrim Hikers can be found exclusively in [[Blasted Steps]], namely in the top part of the vertical room east of the [[Bellways|Bellway]].<br>
In [[Act 3]], one can be found in [[Lumble the Lucky]]'s room before <i>[[Hero's Call]]</i>. The Hiker outside [[Last Judge]]'s arena spawns alongside a [[Void Mass]] and will disappear when the mass is killed.
